prompt:
Hey, you're the Pipeline Architect agent. This is P0 — the most important quality-of-life problem in Mission Control right now.

THE PROBLEM: Ephratah has ideas constantly — on his phone watching Instagram reels, talking to friends, at work, in the shower. Right now his workflow is: see something cool -> copy link to a one-person Discord group chat -> hope he remembers to process it later. Ideas pile up, never get triaged, and get lost. When he finally sits down at MC, he has to paste URLs one by one, breaking whatever context he's in.

The current barriers:
1. Phone -> MC has no bridge (MC is localhost)
2. Ideas need REASONING, not just filing. A raw Instagram link needs "is this relevant? what would it improve? should it become a task?"
3. Can't break campaign context to process random inspiration
4. When not at home (work laptop, phone), there's zero way to interact with MC
5. Radar page exists but is underutilized for R&D intake

WHAT TO BUILD: Not just an inbox. A full idea capture and reasoning pipeline. Think about this deeply.

Requirements:
- Must work from phone (same WiFi for now, but think about remote too)
- Must REASON about ideas, not just dump them. When I paste a link, tell me why it matters.
- Must not clutter Dispatch. Ideas need a staging area before becoming tasks.
- Should connect to Radar for research/inspiration items
- Should be mobile-friendly (big buttons, easy paste, voice input if possible)
- Must work with the existing MC architecture (server.js, localhost:3033)

For the localhost phone access: MC runs on 3033. Phone on same WiFi can hit http://<PC-IP>:3033. Build a /capture page optimized for mobile.

But also think bigger:
- Could a Telegram bot bridge the gap for when you're not on WiFi?
- Could the system watch a shared file (iCloud, OneDrive) for new items?
- What about the @agentic.james approach of texting Claude from phone?

ALSO: Process the Discord dump at .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/discord-dump-2026-03-07.md. These are raw ideas that need to be triaged and either filed to Radar, Dispatch, or discarded. Reason about each one.

ALSO: Build a President's Report page at /president. This is a mode-aware summary page:
- In Home mode: summarizes MC campaign status, personal tasks, what's hot
- In Work mode: summarizes work tasks, CARES status, what to focus on
- Always shows: top 3 priorities, recent wins, blockers
- Think CEO dashboard, not developer dashboard

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first. Rule #10 is critical.

Key files:
- .claude/agent-hub/server.js (add routes for /capture and /president)
- .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/discord-dump-2026-03-07.md (raw ideas to triage)
- .claude/agent-hub/sources.json (Radar data)
- .claude/agent-hub/dispatch-home.json (where triaged ideas go)
- .claude/agent-hub/campaigns.json (campaign context)

DON'T touch campaigns-page.html, hook.js, or prompt-hook.js.

Design: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, DM Sans body, DM Mono data. Apple-inspired. Mobile-first for /capture. CLAUDE.md Rule #10.

This should genuinely change how Ephratah works. Think deeply, then build.

The /president page needs a major iteration. It's a 4/10 right now — too much information, feels like a duplicate of campaigns. Here's what's
  wrong and what I want:

  PROBLEMS:
  - It's showing me ALL the blockers and P0s in scrollable lists. I don't want to scroll through 27 blockers. That's what Dispatch is for.
  - "Recent Wins" is showing post-mortems as wins. That's wrong.
  - The Active Campaign section is just a copy of what's on /campaigns. Redundant.
  - Top 5 Priorities are showing old/stale items like "Set up home PC git flow" which was done ages ago.
  - Too much information density. I come to this page to get a FEELING for where things are, not to read every task.

  WHAT I ACTUALLY WANT:
  Think of this as the page I see FIRST when I sit down. It should answer 3 questions in 10 seconds:
  1. "What should I focus on right now?" (1-3 things, not 5)
  2. "How are things going overall?" (a vibe, not a list)
  3. "Is anything on fire?" (blockers only if they're real emergencies)

  Design inspiration: a weather app. You open it, you see the temperature and a sun icon. That's it. You KNOW what to do. No scrolling. No
  parsing.

  CONCRETE CHANGES:
  - Hero section: just a greeting + ONE sentence summary. "2 agents running. 3 P0s need attention. Campaign is 70% complete."
  - Focus card: THE one thing to do next. Big, bold, impossible to miss. Not a list of 5.
  - Mood indicator: green/amber/red based on ratio of done vs blocked items. Just a color and a word.
  - Kill the scrollable lists. Kill the Active Campaign copy. Kill the Recent Wins section.
  - Quick links at bottom are fine, keep those.
  - The whole page should fit on one screen without scrolling.

  Redesign president-page.html with these changes. Keep the mode-aware filtering. Keep the greeting. Kill everything else and rebuild simpler.
